name: shoulder-on-fhir-sdc-generic-frontend
description: Generic SDC form filler and definition-based extraction engine. Holds no knowledge of any registry: it is given Questionnaires and returns a transaction Bundle.

scripts.pretest: esbuild src/lib/sdcExtract.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/sdcExtract.mjs --external:fhirpath && esbuild src/lib/templateExtract.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/templateExtract.mjs --external:fhirpath && esbuild src/lib/populate.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/populate.mjs --external:fhirpath && esbuild src/lib/profileTypes.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/profileTypes.mjs --external:fhirpath && esbuild src/lib/formLogic.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/formLogic.mjs && esbuild src/lib/response.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist-test/response.mjs
scripts.test: node test/extract.test.mjs && node test/declares-required.test.mjs && node test/sdc-spec-examples.test.mjs
